title: Quantum incapacity from observable shadows
summary: Quantum communication is ruled out when an eavesdropper can reconstruct the receiver's state. Yet states are operationally specified by measurement statistics, raising a sharper question: can access to every expectation value destroy communication? We show that it can. We call unbiased, variance-nonincreasing reconstruction under arbitrary reference extensions \emph{complete observable shadowing} and prove that it forces unassisted private and quantum capacities to vanish.
